answers.answer:
Across three source families, cod carries low lead, cadmium, mercury, nickel, and aluminum and a much larger amount of total arsenic, most of which is not inorganic arsenic.

What heavy metals are found in cod? Studies measured lead, cadmium, total mercury, total arsenic, nickel, chromium, and aluminum in cod. Frozen Pacific cod averaged 11 µg/kg lead, 10 µg/kg cadmium, 31 µg/kg total mercury, 160 µg/kg total arsenic, 100 µg/kg nickel, and 140 µg/kg aluminum, wet weight.

How much mercury is in cod? Total mercury was 44 to 140 µg/kg in US baked cod composites and averaged 31 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod. Stockfish held 140 µg/kg and baccala 270 µg/kg as sold.

Is the arsenic in cod dangerous? Cod carries total arsenic of 160 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and 1,300 to 10,900 µg/kg in baked US composites. None of these studies measured inorganic arsenic, the form that limits regulate, so the risk cannot be judged from these totals.

Does cod contain lead? Lead averaged 11 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and was below the 4 µg/kg reporting limit in all 27 US baked cod composites. Retail products in Italy held 10 to 80 µg/kg, with the highest values in baccala and stockfish.

Is cadmium a concern in cod? Cadmium averaged 10 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and reached 11 µg/kg in US baked composites. Baccala held 60 µg/kg as sold, which the authors flagged against the 50 µg/kg fish muscle limit.

Has aluminum been measured in cod? Only one study measured aluminum, finding an average of 140 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod, with a range of 110 to 150 µg/kg. The Italian survey and the US Total Diet Study did not report aluminum.

Does cod contain nickel? Nickel averaged 100 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod. It was detected once in 27 US baked composites, at 46 µg/kg, and only in the stockfish and baccala in the Italian survey.

Is salted or dried cod higher in metals than fresh cod? Yes, in the Italian survey baccala and stockfish carried the highest lead, cadmium, mercury, arsenic, and nickel of all ten products. Part of this reflects water loss, since the values are as sold.

Is the fish sold as cod always true cod? No, eight of ten Italian retail products sold as cod were hake, Alaska pollock, or saithe.

Does processing change heavy metals in cod? Drying, salting, and baking remove water and raise the concentration per kilogram. No cited source measured a step that removes metals from cod.

What limits apply to metals in cod? The EU sets 300 µg/kg lead, 50 µg/kg cadmium, and 300 µg/kg mercury for Atlantic cod muscle.

What should a cod test report? It should report lead, cadmium, total mercury, speciated arsenic, nickel, and aluminum with a stated basis and quantification limits near a few µg/kg.
